structural_evidence.note: Brings in CARDDEMO-COMMAREA which declares CDEMO-ACCT-ID (PIC 9(11)) at offset CDEMO-ACCOUNT-INFO
Whole-record MOVE INTO CARDDEMO-COMMAREA; CDEMO-ACCT-ID travels with the record but is not named individually
EXEC CICS RETURN COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) — whole record passed back to CICS; CDEMO-ACCT-ID included opaquely
EXEC CICS XCTL COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) — whole record transferred to target program; CDEMO-ACCT-ID included opaquely

programs.notes: COPYs COCOM01Y which declares CARDDEMO-COMMAREA containing CDEMO-ACCT-ID. The record is used three times as an opaque whole (one MOVE-INTO from DFHCOMMAREA, one CICS RETURN COMMAREA, one CICS XCTL COMMAREA) but CDEMO-ACCT-ID — and all other ACCT-ID aliases — are never named individually anywhere in the file. This program is a user-management (update) function; account ID is carried in the commarea for context routing only.
